definition_of_done_items.criterion: Skips blocked by lint unless issue-linked
definition_of_done_items.evidence: Implemented in #619 (b8ed885c9) as a lint-stage gate rather than an eslint rule; it runs in CI's Lint & Format job and as a required pre-ship step. The audit of 2026-11-12 looked only in eslint.config.mjs and so recorded it as not started.
All skips reconciled when the gate landed; 15 skip sites remain today, all linked (14 annotated, 1 allow-listed).
The gate is not part of `pnpm lint` (turbo lint); it runs beside it in the same CI job. The CSV's verified-by is corrected to `pnpm validate:flaky-test-gate` in the same change.

notes: No code change: the work shipped in #619 and has been enforced since. An eslint rule doing the same check was considered and not added, because it would duplicate an enforced gate. This change records the evidence, corrects the row's verified-by command, and closes the row.
